events.input: $ U=https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev; for p in /onboarding/ /onboarding/guides/ /onboarding/guides/s5-follow-ups/ /onboarding/guides/s5-follow-ups/index.html /onboarding/guides/s1-cold-email/ /onboarding/reference/ /onboarding/templates/; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "$p %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url} (%{size_download})\n" "$U$p"; done; grep -n -i "guides" /private/tmp/t259-deploy/cloud/src/index.ts | head -8 | cut -c1-220; ls /private/tmp/t259-deploy/cloud/public/onboarding/guides | head -30 | tr '\n' ' '; ls /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud/public/onboarding/guides |
